title: Fortress Front
concept: Two mirrored forward positions face a shared battlefield. Broken low defensive shoulders offer several sorties, while paired expansion fields sit beyond the home perimeter.
difference: This is a two-position front with open exits and exposed outer economy, not four isolated bases enclosed by arena rings.
routes: A direct sortie from each position faces the shared center.
Two side exits let armies move around the forward shoulder and pressure outer expansions.
The generated ramp carver preserves tank access between positions and resource pairs.
economy: Opening resources remain protected beside each start. Shared mirrored expansion pairs extend beyond each defensive shoulder and pull fighting away from the home perimeter.
core_wishes: Registry and watermark assignment by the core integration owner.
